Test Scenario: Verify bottom nav API returns animation configuration field specifying animating icon
Test Data (Request): Standard authenticated bottom nav API request
Test Steps:
1. Launch app (cold start)
2. Capture bottom nav list API request/response
3. Inspect animation configuration fields
Expected Result (Response): API response includes field specifying which bottom nav icon should auto-play (e.g. icon identifier matching Live TV / On Demand / Favourites / My Account)

Test Scenario: Verify bottom nav API returns configurable animation loop count
Test Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Capture bottom nav API response
3. Verify loop count field
Expected Result (Response): API response includes animation loop count field with value matching CMS configuration (2 for first release)

Test Scenario: Verify bottom nav API returns Lottie animation asset URLs for bottom nav icons
Preconditions: CMS configured with animation Lottie assets
Test Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Capture bottom nav API response
3. Verify Lottie URL fields for animatable icons
Expected Result (Response): API response includes Lottie animation asset URLs for Live TV, On Demand, Favourites, and My Account icons as documented in FSD Animation Assets section

Test Scenario: Verify API graceful handling when animation configuration fields are absent
Test Steps:
1. Configure CMS/API to omit animation fields
2. Cold start app
3. Capture API response and app behaviour
Expected Result (Response): API returns valid bottom nav list without animation fields; app skips auto-play and uses fallback static icons without error
